controls.name: kind
controls.doc: The generator kinds, in surface order: its position is the integer omx-dsp's omx_gen_fill takes as its kind (OMX_GEN_OSC, OMX_GEN_WHITE, OMX_GEN_PINK).

controls.name: waveform
controls.doc: The selectable oscillator waveforms, in surface order: its position is the integer omx-dsp's omx_gen_osc takes (OMX_WAVE_SINE, OMX_WAVE_SQUARE, OMX_WAVE_SAW, OMX_WAVE_TRIANGLE).

controls.name: oscillatorFreq
controls.doc: The oscillator's frequency travel: the audible band, 20 Hz to 20 kHz, stepped by 10 Hz on a nudge. omx-dsp's omx_gen_osc takes the frequency in Hz.
